transforms.reason: Keep turns of 20-240 scheduled minutes. Shorter is a data error or a through-flight; longer is an aircraft parked for hours, not a turn. Counts over all 12 months.
Model only late inbound arrivals of 0-180 minutes: early arrivals cannot propagate lateness and extreme delays (over three hours) are rare and often involve aircraft swaps.
Cancelled and diverted flights have no arrival delay or cause minutes, so they are excluded from delay statistics and counted separately (this removes some of the worst disruption).
